audience: builders who hit the 'my GPU can't hold this model' wall and self-hosters who want to run big open models without a datacenter
single_takeaway: mesh-llm runs a model too big for any one machine by splitting its layers live across a peer-to-peer mesh, served as one ordinary OpenAI endpoint.
desired_feeling: quiet awe that a model can live across machines and still answer like one endpoint
